verdict.rationale: The official Nitrokey 3 firmware repository on GitHub states it is fully open source. It is written in Rust, dual licensed under Apache 2.0 and MIT, and has tagged public releases, so a user can read the source under an open license. A community report says the original Nitrokey HSM applet is not free/open source, which limits this to the Nitrokey 3 firmware rather than the whole product line. Missing for 10: open-source coverage across all Nitrokey products (the HSM applet is reported closed), and independent corroboration of the licensing beyond the vendor repository.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: This software is fully open source.
All software, unless otherwise noted, is dual licensed under Apache 2.0 and MIT license.
The Nitrokey 3 firmware is written in Rust.
